input: Find nature, outdoor adventure, farm, horseback riding and fishing summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Waynesville, Canton, Clyde, Maggie Valley and Lake Junaluska, NC (Haywood County). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Haywood county summer camp 2026 outdoor nature horses fishing kids

candidates.name: Skyland Camp & Retreats
candidates.note: 2027 girls’ overnight camps for rising grades 1–10, plus mother-daughter camps; riding and outdoor activities.

candidates.name: SOAR
candidates.note: Outdoor-adventure summer camps for children and teens with ADHD and learning differences.

candidates.name: Daniel Boone Council, Scouting America
candidates.note: Camp Daniel Boone offers Scout base camp, high adventure and living-history programs; 2027 registration announced.

candidates.name: Lake Logan
candidates.note: Camp Henry’s 2026 offerings included traditional camp, outdoor school, teen leadership, mini camp and Butterfly Camp.

candidates.name: Haywood County Soil and Water Conservation District
candidates.note: One-week Youth Environmental Stewardship camp for rising grades 8–9; regional field trips and environmental science.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension, Haywood County Center
candidates.note: 2026 local 4-H Summer Fun included an archery clinic, Farm to Fork cooking camp, STEM and craft programs.

candidates.name: Town of Canton Parks and Recreation
candidates.note: Summer day camp at Recreation Park with outdoor games, crafts, swimming and weekly themes.

candidates.name: Stockton Farms
candidates.note: 2026 summer Scout clinics in horsemanship and animal science on a working farm near Camp Daniel Boone.
